args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges are now structured to track weekly diesel prices.
- Per the companion piece, shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Halvorsen Freight Readings — Combined Summary (2026)
